name: Container Corporation of India Ltd.
business_summary: Government-controlled (54.8%) rail container logistics operator: inland container depots, rail haulage for EXIM (~75% of TEU) and domestic cargo, warehousing, port and cold-chain activities. Revenue Rs9.1k cr TTM (+1%), EBITDA Rs1.94k cr (21%), PAT Rs1.22k cr, debt-free. Q2 FY27 throughput 14.48 lakh TEU (+0.53% y/y); H1 +4.48%. Q2 consolidated profit Rs353.7 cr (vs Rs380.0 cr), interim dividend Rs1.90 (record 2026-11-11). Competes with private container train operators and trucking; pays Indian Railways haulage charges.

cost_structure.input: railway haulage charges and terminal access

exposures.mechanism: EXIM ~75% of TEU volume; US ~15-18% of India's container exports (estimate). +10pp tariff => exports -3% (US-bound -15%) => EXIM -1.5% => total volume -1.1% => revenue -Rs100 cr at ~60% drop-through = -Rs60 cr = -3.1% EBITDA (Rs1,936 cr); EV/MCap ~0.88 (net cash); persistence 0.5 => -1.4. EXIM volume was flat in Q2 FY27 (-0.07% per one source) vs H1 +4.6%.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 throughput 14,48,379 TEU (+0.53% y/y); EXIM ~-0.07%, domestic +2.4% (sources differ)
FY27 guidance 9.5% volume growth, domestic +15%; H1 growth only 4.48%
